research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Rainforest QA is focused on enhancing automated testing for electronic products. Their R&D efforts include a system with a processing unit that executes files for product testing based on specific instructions. Additionally, they are developing methods for evaluating product testing, involving communication between databases associated with analytic tools and electronic testing devices. These innovations aim to streamline the testing process for web and mobile applications, ensuring efficient and effective evaluation of product functionality.

overview_description.description:
At Rainforest, we know you need to ship fast, with confidence. To achieve that, you need an easy-to-create, easy-to-maintain QA testing platform. 

We understand that QA can be tough to manage when you’re stuck in the QA gap between the scrappy “ship everything” stage and enterprise-level code-first frameworks. That’s why we’ve helped thousands of startups run more than 60M tests to ship products faster with AI-driven QA that anyone can run on Rainforest.

product.name: Rainforest QA Platform
product.description: A cloud-based no-code test automation platform that creates, runs, and maintains end-to-end tests for web and mobile applications.

product.name: Test Manager Service
product.description: A dedicated QA expert who creates, maintains, and monitors automated tests using the Rainforest platform, handling test failures and updates.

product.name: AI-Assisted Self-Healing Test Maintenance
product.description: An AI-driven feature that automatically updates test scripts to reflect changes in the application, reducing manual test maintenance.

product.name: Exploratory Testing Service
product.description: A manual testing service where expert testers explore the application to find bugs and usability issues beyond automated test coverage.

product.name: CI/CD and Communication Integrations
product.description: Integrations with popular CI/CD tools and communication platforms to automate test execution and streamline bug reporting and notifications.
